text:
Ashley Tran: quick Q — setting up the new eu-dedicated pool (eu-west-2). Where's the single dashboard that shows per-pool saturation, KV cache hit/evict rate, and autoscale timeline? need to point SRE execs to one link.
Tom B: there's a dashboard we use: Grafana > Dedicated Pools > Pool Overview. filter var-pool=eu-west-2. link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/dedicated-pools/overview?var-pool=eu-west-2 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Tom B: panels to open: 'saturation_ratio', 'autoscale_events', 'kvcache_eviction_rate', 'token_throughput'
Li Wong: PromQL snippets you can paste into a panel:
```
avg_over_time(pool_saturation_ratio{pool="eu-west-2"}[5m])
rate(kvcache_evictions_total{pool="eu-west-2"}[5m]) / rate(kvcache_hits_total{pool="eu-west-2"}[5m])
count_over_time(autoscale_event_total{pool="eu-west-2"}[1h])
```
Li Wong: also watch `steal_queue_depth` and `scale_down_in_flight` if you're troubleshooting false positives.
Devon R: re alerting: we've been getting noisy alerts for eu pools. Proposed change in PR #4982: raise saturation alert from 0.7->0.85 and require 10m continuous. pinging @oncall for review.
Kevin M: fwiw, those 2m spikes are usually client bursts; suggest adding a 'burst suppression' rule: let small blips (<= 2m, <10% above threshold) not fire. can add in the alerting expression.
sre-bot: scheduled maintenance window for eu-west-2 detected; suppress alerts between 2034567200 and 2034569000. (auto-suppression)
ops-bot: dashboard runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.net/display/OPS/Dedicated+Pool+Runbook -> includes which panels map to playbook steps.
Ashley Tran: perfect, i'll link the grafana panels in the doc and approve PR #4982 after @oncall gives thumbs up. thanks all :raised_hands:
Tom B: quick tip — when you share the grafana link, use the panel anchors (add &panelId=42 etc.) so execs land on saturation panel.
Ashley Tran: ok doing that, will also flag the kvcache evict rate in the runbook.
